question: Is there any form in which the supreme Lord cannot appear?
premises: The supreme Lord is full of freedom.
Because of that fullness he accomplishes even the most difficult deeds.
His appearing is not limited to any particular form.
inference: The supreme Lord can shine in any form whatsoever due to the fullness of his freedom.
plain_english: Thus, because he is full of freedom and able to accomplish even the most difficult deeds, in what form indeed does the supreme Lord not shine?
